methods.label: Interpreting sample conclusions
methods.explanation: A statistical case study should report both the source of the data and the limitations of its conclusions. A sample includes only part of the population, so population conclusions drawn from it should be treated as estimates. The sampling method affects how well the sample represents the population, so it should be explained. Therefore, choose B.
